translations.source: The binary has NX bit set. This marks a memory page non-executable making attacker injected shellcode non-executable.
translations.text: 二进制已设置 NX 位，将内存页标记为不可执行，使攻击者注入的 shellcode 无法执行。

translations.source: The binary does not have NX bit set. NX bit offer protection against exploitation of memory corruption vulnerabilities by marking memory page as non-executable. However iOS never allows an app to execute from writeable memory. You do not need to specifically enable the ‘NX bit’ because it’s always enabled for all third-party code.
translations.text: 二进制未设置 NX 位。NX 通过将内存页标记为不可执行来防御内存破坏漏洞利用。不过，iOS 不允许应用执行可写内存中的代码，第三方代码始终受此保护，因此无需单独启用 NX 位。

translations.source: The binary is build with -fPIC flag which enables Position independent code. This makes Return Oriented Programming (ROP) attacks much more difficult to execute reliably.
translations.text: 二进制使用 -fPIC 标志构建，启用了位置无关代码，使返回导向编程（ROP）攻击更难可靠执行。

translations.source: The binary is built without Position Independent Code flag. In order to prevent an attacker from reliably jumping to, for example, a particular exploited function in memory, Address space layout randomization (ASLR) randomly arranges the address space positions of key data areas of a process, including the base of the executable and the positions of the stack,heap and libraries. Use compiler option -fPIC to enable Position Independent Code. Not applicable for dylibs and static libraries.
translations.text: 二进制未启用位置无关代码。地址空间布局随机化（ASLR）会随机安排可执行文件、栈、堆及库等关键数据区域的位置，增加攻击者可靠跳转到特定内存函数的难度。可使用编译选项 -fPIC 启用位置无关代码。此检查不适用于动态库和静态库。

translations.source: This binary has a stack canary value added to the stack so that it will be overwritten by a stack buffer that overflows the return address. This allows detection of overflows by verifying the integrity of the canary before function return.
translations.text: 二进制在栈中加入了 Canary 值；栈缓冲区溢出并覆盖返回地址时，该值也会被覆盖。在函数返回前检查 Canary 的完整性，可以检测栈溢出。

translations.source: The binary is compiled with Automatic Reference Counting (ARC) flag. ARC is a compiler feature that provides automatic memory management of Objective-C objects and is an exploit mitigation mechanism against memory corruption vulnerabilities.
translations.text: 二进制启用了自动引用计数（ARC）编译标志。ARC 自动管理 Objective-C 对象的内存，可缓解内存破坏漏洞的利用。

translations.source: The binary has Runpath Search Path (@rpath) set. In certain cases an attacker can abuse this feature to run arbitrary executable for code execution and privilege escalation. Remove the compiler option -rpath to remove @rpath.
translations.text: 二进制设置了运行时搜索路径（@rpath）。在某些情况下，攻击者可滥用该功能运行任意可执行文件，造成代码执行或权限提升。可移除编译选项 -rpath 来移除 @rpath。

translations.source: The binary does not have Runpath Search Path (@rpath) set.
translations.text: 二进制未设置运行时搜索路径（@rpath）。

translations.source: Debug Symbols are available. To strip debugging symbols, set Strip Debug Symbols During Copy to YES, Deployment Postprocessing to YES, and Strip Linked Product to YES in project's build settings.
translations.text: 二进制保留了调试符号。可在项目构建设置中将 Strip Debug Symbols During Copy、Deployment Postprocessing 和 Strip Linked Product 均设置为 YES，剥离调试符号。

translations.source: This binary has debug symbols stripped. We cannot identify whether stack canary is enabled or not.
translations.text: 二进制已剥离调试符号，无法判断是否启用了栈保护（Stack Canary）。

translations.source: This binary has debug symbols stripped. We cannot identify whether ARC is enabled or not.
translations.text: 二进制已剥离调试符号，无法判断是否启用了自动引用计数（ARC）。

translations.source: The binary is not compiled with Automatic Reference Counting (ARC) flag. ARC is a compiler feature that provides automatic memory management of Objective-C objects and protects from memory corruption vulnerabilities. Use compiler option -fobjc-arc to enable ARC or set Objective-C Automatic Reference Counting to YES in project configuration.
translations.text: 二进制未启用自动引用计数（ARC）编译标志。ARC 自动管理 Objective-C 对象的内存，有助于防御内存破坏漏洞。可使用 -fobjc-arc 编译选项，或在项目中将 Objective-C Automatic Reference Counting 设置为 YES。

translations.source: This binary does not have a stack canary value added to the stack. Stack canaries are used to detect and prevent exploits from overwriting return address. Use the option -fstack-protector-all to enable stack canaries.
translations.text: 二进制未启用栈保护（Stack Canary）。栈保护用于检测并阻止对返回地址的覆盖利用。可使用 -fstack-protector-all 编译选项启用。

translations.source: This binary does not have a stack canary value added to the stack. Stack canaries are used to detect and prevent exploits from overwriting return address. Use the option -fstack-protector-all to enable stack canaries. This might be okey for pure Swift dylibs.
translations.text: 二进制未启用栈保护（Stack Canary）。栈保护用于检测并阻止对返回地址的覆盖利用。可使用 -fstack-protector-all 编译选项启用。 对纯 Swift 动态库而言，这种情况可能是正常的。
